description: Create an outbound money movement (POST /v1/money_movements): source account/balance, destination counterparty, amount and currency. Runs over Colombia's instant rails or Mexico's SPEI depending on the destination.

amount.description: Amount in minor units unless the account currency says otherwise

currency.description: Currency code, e.g. COP or MXN

source_id.description: Source account/balance id the funds leave from

name: create_money_movement
